comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels: channel 1 waits on mark 1 between the label LAB1 and REPEAT LAB1 P=2, which repeats those lines twice after the first pass (three passes, Siemens' own example: P=4 makes five squares); channel 2 writes mark 1 three times. The jump lines named only the REPEAT line, so the count was a mismatch (1 against 3); followed: correct, no finding.
